visibility.admin: You're an admin and see every meeting in the company.
visibility.placed: You see meetings for {group}, every group below it and the whole company.
visibility.unplaced: You don't have a place in the company yet. You only see meetings you start or attend. An admin places you under People.

start.title: Start a meeting
start.text: You choose who the meeting is for before you start. The Doc and the summary go only to people who may see the meeting.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.emptyText: The meetings you may see show up here. Start the first one above.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: A customer is added by itself when someone from another company is invited to the meeting in your calendar. Only the e-mail domain is stored, never addresses.
customers.emptyText: Connect your calendar and start a meeting with a guest from another company. The customer then shows up here.
customers.meetings: {count, plural, =0 {No meetings you can see} one {# meeting} other {# meetings}}
customers.tasks: {count, plural, =0 {no open tasks} one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
customers.noMeetings: You can't see any meetings with this customer.

people.title: People & groups
people.intro: Everyone sits at one place in the tree. You see your group's meetings and every meeting in groups further down. Admins see everything.
people.readOnly: Only admins can change the tree.
people.archiveText: The group leaves the tree and its people lose their place. Old meetings stay.
people.unplacedText: They only see meetings they start or attend.
people.membersText: Joined through an invite but not in the tree yet.

settings.name: Name
settings.inviteText: Whoever opens the link joins without a place in the tree. Then place them under People & groups.
settings.adminsText: Admins (for example the CEO and management) see every meeting, customer and task and can change the tree.
settings.dangerText: Every meeting, note and customer is deleted. The Docs in Google Drive stay with whoever started the meeting.
settings.leaveText: You'll no longer see the company's meetings. An admin can invite you again.

picker.label: Meeting for
picker.privateHint: Only you, the attendees you tick and admins see the meeting.
picker.seesWhole: Who sees it: everyone in the company with a place in the tree.
picker.seesPrivate: Who sees it: you, the attendees you tick and admins.
picker.seesGroup: Who sees it: {group}, the groups above it and admins.
picker.eventHint: The meeting then gets the event's name, and the colleagues you tick below count as attendees and see the meeting, even a private one.
picker.noColleagues: No colleagues are invited to the event.
picker.seesAttendees: {count, plural, one {Plus # attendee you ticked.} other {Plus # attendees you ticked.}}

orgs.createText: A company has a tree of groups. Everyone sees their group's meetings and everything below it. Tasks are suggested, never required.
orgs.name: Company name
